Meta’s AI app Muse has reached No.

2 on the US App Store after more than 83,000 iPhone downloads, up from No.

4 in a few days.

The figure is still well below the early performance of Threads, Meta AI and ChatGPT.

These estimates cover only US App Store downloads—not Android, web or WhatsApp usage—so they are not a complete measure of adoption.
